messages:
Priya (Sales): Hey team — ACME needs a hosted POC. Requirements: per-environment API key, IP allowlist, max lifetime 72h, scoped to embeddings + gpt-4-compat, and automatic rotation every 48h. Can SE provision and advise on secure handoff?
Alex (Sales): Quick q — do they need a UI link for key or prefer a short-lived token sent to their engineer?
Priya (Sales): They want an automated handoff to their infra engineer via a pre-authenticated download link. Also need audit entries for key creation & rotation.
Jamie (SE): We can do a scoped API key via the Console with an allowed model list + IP CIDR. Flow: create key, set TTL, enable "auto-rotate" and generate a secure download URL that expires. Ops-bot can log creation.
Jamie (SE): Steps I recommend: 1) create key with role=poc-scoped, models=[redwood-4-compat, embed-1], 2) attach IP allowlist (x.x.x.0/24), 3) TTL=72h, rotation interval=48h, 4) upload metadata to audit.
Priya (Sales): Can you paste the exact curl we should show the customer for testing? Keep token placeholder.
Jamie (SE): Sure — example curl: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_test_REDACTED" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-4-compat","input":"hi"}'```
Alex (Sales): We'll avoid emailing tokens. Use the expiring download link + one-time passphrase. Customer accepts that.
Jamie (SE): I'll provision the first key and set rotation. ops-bot, please create the audit entry and generate secure URL.
ops-bot: Created key id pk_live:acme_poc_227890. Secure download: https://secrets.redwood/download/eyJ... (expires in 4h). Audit: key.create by Jamie (SE) at 2278901236. Rotation scheduled every 48h, TTL 72h.
Priya (Sales): Perfect. Who's responsible for revocation if the POC ends early?
Jamie (SE): We (SE) can revoke on request; Sales must file a quick ticket in #support with subject "revoke acme_poc key". I can also attach an auto-revoke date in the key metadata.
Alex (Sales): I'll open the ticket once the engineering handoff is validated. Also confirm logs will show IP allowlist enforcement.
ops-bot: Confirmed: enforcement logs for network events are available in Console -> Audit -> Network for key id acme_poc_227890.
Jamie (SE): After POC ends, revocation steps: Console -> Keys -> Revoke -> Confirm. Then we rotate any shared infra tokens. I'll drop a short automation next week to revoke stale POC keys older than 7d.
Priya (Sales): Thanks — I'll update the SOW and share the secure link with customer infra. Keep me posted if any blockers. :thumbsup:
Alex (Sales): Noted. Closing loop after handoff.
Jamie (SE): Done provisioning, ping me if the download link fails.
Priya (Sales): Added note to customer email: "Key will auto-rotate every 48h and expire after 72h. For emergency revocation, contact sales@redwood.com and request key revoke."
Alex (Sales): Great. Thread done.
